## BasesViewFactory type

Implement this factory function in a [BasesViewRegistration](BasesViewRegistration.md) to create a new instance of a custom Bases view.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type BasesViewFactory = (controller: QueryController, containerEl: HTMLElement) => BasesView;
```
